_comment: Every risk number Theta Gate enforces, in one place. Rendered verbatim in the Streamlit dashboard next to the line 'no LLM can write to this file'. No LLM does — brain.py never imports json.dump against this path.

strategy._dte_comment: PK target of 5-10% by EOW, 1 Sep 2026: 6-9 -> 3-5. THE BINDING CONSTRAINT WAS TENOR, NOT SIZE. Everything is force-closed Thu 3 Sep, so a 9-DTE spread entered Tuesday is held two sessions of a nine-day life and captures ~35% of its credit -- the premium being sold sits in days the competition does not have. Measured on the live position: $0.61 -> $0.49 in one session. At 3-5 DTE the same delta and the same defined risk capture ~70-80% by Thursday, which roughly doubles the return per unit of margin. The canonical plan's 6-9 argument was about avoiding the 2-DTE time exit in a normal week; with a hard Thursday flatten that reasoning inverts. Still never 0DTE -- no greeks, so the delta rule has no input.
strategy._credit_quality_comment: Verified live 26 Aug 2026: credit/width is NOT a fixed 0.20-0.45 band. It tracks ~0.8 x short_delta and falls as width increases (5-wide 0.120 -> 25-wide 0.056). This gate catches a bad quote relative to that curve, not an absolute ratio.
strategy._min_credit_comment: Fable 5 strategy review, 28 Aug 2026: an absolute floor, separate from the relative credit_quality check above. At the low end of the delta band (0.16) with the relative check's own -40% tolerance, credit can fall to ~$0.38 on a $5 spread and still pass the relative test -- too thin to be worth the mechanical and execution risk. This gate catches that case.
strategy._fixed_quantity_comment: Canonical plan Sec 2.12, 29 Aug 2026: exactly one contract for the entire hackathon, not just the first trade. A 5-session sample cannot justify scaling; size_position() no longer computes qty from a max-loss budget.
strategy._sizing_comment: PK, 1 Sep 2026: sized to a hard 50%-of-account deployment cap. 33 contracts x 3 positions x $500 margin = $49,500. Size scales with the proposer's confidence between min_contracts and max_contracts; the LLM does NOT size the position -- it supplies one input to a deterministic function whose bounds live in this file, which no LLM can write to, and gate_max_loss_per_trade / gate_total_open_risk / gate_buying_power_floor all veto the result independently. The delta band is deliberately UNCHANGED: at 50% deployment the existing 0.16-0.25 band already targets ~6%, and widening to 0.30 would buy 2.8 more points of upside for 10 points of win probability -- a bad trade, and it would change the one strategy parameter the whole write-up is built on.
strategy._sizing_threshold_comment: confidence_floor/ceiling are the model's own [0,1] scale, NOT fitted to observed output. Every confidence seen so far is 0.60-0.62 (four proposals, 31 Aug), so a threshold placed near 0.6 would be tuned to four data points -- the exact criticism levelled at the VRP re-base. Effective step-up is at 0.75, which those proposals do NOT reach: the mechanism is live but inert until the model expresses genuine conviction. Deliberate.
strategy._sizing_signal_comment: 1 Sep 2026, docs/STRATEGY-REVIEW-2026-09-01 Sec 5: size on MEASURED variance risk premium rather than the model's self-reported confidence. Across every live proposal on 31 Aug the model answered 0.60, 0.60, 0.60, 0.62 -- a constant carries no signal, so sizing on it was sizing on nothing. VRP is the edge this strategy claims, it is measured from the chain and the bars, and it varies. Set sizing_signal to 'confidence' to switch back.

entry._deadline_comment: Canonical plan Sec 4.3, 29 Aug 2026: Wednesday is morning-only (the afternoon window is dropped — a spread needs enough runway before Thursday's flatten to cover its own bid-ask round trip). This value previously read 16:00, which wrongly left the Wednesday afternoon window open. Sep 4 is NFP day, 08:30 ET, verified against bls.gov this session (data/events_2026-08-31_2026-09-04.json) and falls after Thursday's flatten, so it does not block any entry.

exit._stop_comment: Renamed from stop_loss_multiple_of_credit (canonical plan Sec 2.1, 29 Aug 2026): the multiple applies to the CLOSING DEBIT, not the loss. At credit=$0.60, this multiple gives a $1.20 closing debit and a $0.60 loss (1x credit), not a $1.20 loss. exit_signal()'s arithmetic was already correct — only the name was misleading.
exit._force_close_comment: Canonical plan Sec 8.2, 29 Aug 2026: ladder moved 30 min earlier across the board. The old ladder's forceful rung landed at 15:50, ten minutes before the 16:00 close, with no recovery time if it failed.
exit._time_exit_comment: 2 -> 1, 1 Sep 2026: at 3-5 DTE a time exit at 2 fires the day after entry and gives back most of the decay this change exists to capture. Thursday's force-close ladder is the real exit now; the time exit is a backstop for a position that somehow outlives it.

risk._max_concurrent_comment: PK decision, 31 Aug 2026: 2 -> 3, capped there explicitly. NOTE the interaction that made the old value binding twice: with 2 underlyings and max_positions_per_underlying=1, three concurrent positions were arithmetically unreachable -- min(3, 2x1) = 2. per_underlying goes to 2 so this cap is the real constraint, not a decoration. SPY and QQQ remain ONE correlated bucket: three short-put-spread positions are three expressions of the same short-index-downside trade, and one 2% gap hits all three together. That is the risk being accepted, and the write-up says so plainly.
risk._daily_fill_cap_comment: 1 -> 2, 31 Aug 2026: needed to reach three concurrent positions from two underlyings. A morning fill no longer blocks an afternoon re-entry in the same name. Deliberately loosened; it concentrates same-underlying exposure inside a session.
risk._drawdown_comment: Re-based with the size increase, 1 Sep 2026. Worst case is $41,382 (41% of the account), so the old -1% halt would trip on ordinary intraday noise and freeze the agent for the rest of the week. -6% fires at about a seventh of full exposure; $90,000 fires well before the worst case completes. Both stay REACHABLE -- at 1 contract the old halt could never fire at all, so the whole drawdown layer was decoration.
risk._bp_multiple_comment: 5 -> 3, 1 Sep 2026. This gate, not the risk caps, was the real size ceiling: 5x a position's max loss capped the book at 27 contracts. At 33 contracts the actual post-trade ratio is 3.5x, so 3 is the smallest relaxation that admits the target size -- 2 was drafted first and was more than needed. The absolute $25,000 floor is unchanged and still binds.

regime._comment: Canonical plan Sec 4.6, 29 Aug 2026: entry-only regime filters, sourced from Cboe's public VIX-family CSVs. Never blocks exits or liquidates an open position -- a spike blocks NEW entries only.

vrp._comment: The only edge this strategy claims. Verified live: a fairly priced chain has zero arithmetic edge, negative by exactly the bid-ask cost. Sell premium only when it is actually rich.
vrp._lookback_comment: PK decision, 30 Aug 2026 (option C in docs/ANALYSIS-2026-08-30.md): 20 -> 10 so the realised-vol window matches the 6-9 DTE tenor being sold. The 30 Aug audit found the gate comparing the front of a contango vol curve against a 20-day RV still carrying the 3-4 Aug rally days: on Friday's marks it vetoed every SPY and QQQ candidate for Mon-Tue (SPY IV 9.9-10.1% vs RV20 10.4%; QQQ 14.8-15.2% vs 18.2%). At 10 days: SPY +2.1..+2.3 pts, QQQ +1.3..+1.7.
vrp._min_vrp_points_comment: Canonical plan Sec 4.6, 29 Aug 2026: tightened from a plain IV>=RV check to a 2.0-vol-point margin -- IV barely above RV is noise, not a priced premium. 30 Aug 2026 (PK, option C): re-based to 1.0 together with the 10-day window above; the 2.0 cushion was sized against a 20-day RV. Chosen with Friday's data in view -- disclosed as such in the write-up.
vrp._max_size_comment: Vol points of premium at which sizing reaches max_contracts, scaling linearly from min_vrp_points (1.0, the entry floor). 6.0 is roughly the historical SPX VRP mean and is NOT fitted to this week: Monday's SPY print was ~3.4 points (IV 11.2 vs RV10 7.8), which lands mid-band by arithmetic rather than by tuning.

environment._paper_flag_comment: Case-insensitive membership test only. Never a truthiness cast. Any value outside this set selects live, including 'paper', 'TRUE ' with a trailing space, and 'yes!'.

operational._no_bulk_comment: cancel_all_orders, close_all_positions, close_position, exercise_options_position and do_not_exercise_options_position all require explicit human confirmation on Alpaca's own paper-trading skills, regardless of confirmation_mode. Theta Gate never calls any of them. Every close is an explicit order naming both legs.
